# Legal Information Institute

> Cornell Law's free, open-access repository of U.S. legal materials including federal statutes, Supreme Court decisions, constitutional text, and procedural rules.

The Legal Information Institute (LII) is a non-profit organization at Cornell Law School dedicated to making American legal information freely available to the public. The site provides comprehensive access to federal law, state law, and court decisions without paywalls or registration requirements.

## Primary Legal References

- [U.S. Code: Table Of Contents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text): U.S. Code table of contents and federal statute index
- [U.S. Constitution](https://www.law.cornell.edu/constitution): Full text of U.S. Constitution with articles and amendments
- [Supreme Court: Table Of Contents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/supremecourt/text/home): Supreme Court decisions archive and case search database
- [Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR): Table Of Contents](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text): Electronic Code of Federal Regulations database and index
- [Uniform Commercial Code](https://www.law.cornell.edu/ucc): Uniform Commercial Code for commercial law reference
- [States](https://www.law.cornell.edu/states): State law directory and jurisdiction guide for all U.S. states

## Federal Rules & Procedures

- [Federal Rules of Civil Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frcp): Federal Rules of Civil Procedure for litigation guidance
- [Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frcrmp): Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure reference material
- [Federal Rules of Evidence](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/fre): Federal Rules of Evidence for litigation and judicial procedure
- [Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frap): Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure reference material
- [Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frbp): Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure reference material
